pageTitle: Jewish Leadership Fishing Academy | South Florida
metaDescription: An enrichment program for boys ages 9–15, with weekly after-school fishing lessons and two full-day fishing trips each month. Reserve your spot.

founder.title: Meet Shlomo Dratler
founder.body: Shlomo Dratler is a North Miami Beach native who has spent years working in education and therapy. His approach emphasizes intrinsic motivation, self-awareness and practical responsibility. Jewish Leadership Fishing Academy brings that approach into hands-on fishing, meaningful relationships and Torah values.

items.q: How much does the program cost?
items.a: $650 per boy per month, including weekly after-school fishing lessons and two full-day fishing outings.

items.q: When are the lessons and outings?
items.a: Fishing lessons take place once a week after school. Each boy also participates in two full-day Sunday fishing outings each month. We’ll confirm your group’s schedule with you.

items.q: Where do the fishing outings take place?
items.a: Each month includes one Florida Keys fishing outing and one outing at a suitable South Florida fishing location. We’ll send the destination and arrangements before each trip.
Transportation is included for both full-day fishing outings. Parents arrange drop-off and pickup for the weekly after-school lessons. Trip pickup points and times are provided in advance.

items.q: What does my son need to bring?
items.a: Each boy needs his own rod, reel and personal tackle. We’ll guide you on suitable equipment. Families provide food and drinking water for the outings.

items.q: Will there be other opportunities to get together?
items.a: Yes. We may arrange additional fishing opportunities, tackle-store visits and hands-on demonstrations from time to time. We’ll let families know when these are available and how to join.

items.q: Does my son need fishing experience?
items.a: No prior experience is needed. Lessons build from each boy’s current skills, with new challenges as he becomes more capable.

items.q: What happens after I sign up?
items.a: We’ll contact you to discuss your son, your area and a suitable group. You’ll receive the schedule, enrollment details and required forms before participation is confirmed.
Payment is by credit card or cash. We’ll send payment instructions when your group is ready. Submitting the reservation request does not authorize a charge.

items.q: What happens if my son misses a lesson or trip?
items.a: Let us know at least 24 hours before the activity begins. Your son will keep credit for that lesson or trip, and we’ll arrange a suitable replacement when a place is available.

items.q: What if we decide not to continue?
items.a: If you have paid and withdraw at least 24 hours before your son’s first activity, with no attendance, we retain a $100 administrative fee and refund the rest. If he withdraws after the first lesson and before attending a fishing trip, we retain $200 in total and refund the rest. After he has attended both a lesson and a fishing trip, no refund is available. These rules do not create a fee for a free reservation request and do not limit refund rights required by law.

items.q: What happens if the weather prevents an activity?
items.a: If dangerous weather requires a postponement, we’ll reschedule and preserve credit for the affected activity. We’ll contact you with the revised arrangements.

items.q: Can boys bring phones or tablets?
items.a: No smartphones, tablets or devices that can play or stream videos are allowed at Academy group activities, even if filtered or offline. Dedicated gaming devices are permitted only if they cannot play or stream videos, and only when the instructor allows.

items.q: What are the behavior and safety expectations?
items.a: Boys must speak respectfully, work with the group, follow instructions and stop immediately when told. An ordinary conduct breach receives one clear warning; a further breach leads to removal. Serious unsafe behavior may require immediate removal. Fees already paid for a participant removed for violating the Student Agreement are non-refundable, except where a refund is required by law.

form.title: Reserve Your Spot Now
form.intro: Tell us about your son and where you’re located. We’ll follow up with your group’s dates, location and next steps.
form.drive: How much total driving time are you comfortable with for drop-off and pickup on a lesson day?
form.driveHelp: Count all the driving you expect to do that day. This is for the local after-school lessons, not the full-day fishing trips.
form.agreementIntro: We want every boy to enjoy fishing, work together and take responsibility. Please read these expectations with your son before submitting this form.

agreementSections.title: Respect and collaboration
agreementSections.body: I will speak respectfully, work together with the group, and respect other people, their belongings and our shared equipment. Bullying, threats and deliberately hurting someone are not acceptable.

agreementSections.title: Instructions and safety
agreementSections.body: I will follow the instructor’s directions, stop immediately when told, and stay with the supervised group. I will use rods, hooks, tools and fish-handling equipment only as instructed. I will tell an adult when I need help or notice something unsafe.

agreementSections.title: Phones, tablets and other devices
agreementSections.body: I will not bring a smartphone, tablet, or device that can play or stream videos to any Academy lesson, trip, group journey or other group activity—even if it is filtered or offline. Games and dedicated gaming devices are permitted only when they cannot play or stream videos, and only when the instructor allows.

agreementSections.title: Consequences
agreementSections.body: For an ordinary conduct-rule breach, I will receive one clear warning. If I break the rules again after that warning, I will be removed from the program and may not return. Serious unsafe behavior or refusal to follow an immediate safety instruction may result in removal without a warning.
